Bill.BriefDescription: Allowing small motorcycles to stop and proceed through traffic signals.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to motorcycles at traffic signals; adding a newsection to chapter 46.61 RCW; and providing an effective date.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 46.61 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Notwithstanding any provision of law to the contrary, the operatorof a motorcycle approaching an intersection that is controlled by atraffic control signal using a vehicle detection device that isinoperative due to the size of the motorcycle shall come to a full andcomplete stop at the intersection and, after exercising due care asprovided by law, may proceed with due caution when it is safe to do so.It is not a defense to a violation of RCW 46.61.050 that the driver ofa motorcycle proceeded under the belief that a traffic control signalused a vehicle detection device or was inoperative due to the size ofthe motorcycle when the signal did not use a vehicle detection deviceor that any such device was not in fact inoperative due to the size ofthe motorcycle.
